name: astro-agents
description: Research-grade astronomical data & computation API — NASA/JPL DE440 ephemerides for any date, past, present or future, reproducible and SHA-256 verifiable. Connects the Astro Agents MCP server (20 tools, remote, no install): rise, set and twilight times, altitude and azimuth, Moon phase and distance, the day's sky, planet positions, eclipses with local circumstances, planetary phenomena, seasons, time scales and coordinate conversion. Data only.
